title: Who Are Japan's Biggest-Spending Tourists
paragraphs: Many tourists visit Japan every year. But which tourists spend the most money there? The answer may be surprising.

Japan's Tourism Agency regularly checks how much money foreign visitors spend in Japan. In April to June 2026, visitors from Mexico spent the most money per person. On average, each Mexican visitor spent 514,925 yen. This was more than double the average for all visitors. Visitors from the Middle East were second, and visitors from the UK were third.

The results change often. From July to September 2026, visitors from France spent the most money per person, at 423,021 yen. Mexico was second, and visitors from Nordic countries, such as Sweden and Norway, were third. In 2025, Germany was first.
From July to September 2026, the average for all visitors was 233,677 yen per person. This was 6.1% more than a year earlier.

However, if we look at the total amount of money, the biggest spenders are different. From July to September 2026, visitors from Taiwan spent the most money in total, at 381.8 billion yen. China was second, and South Korea was third. This is because many more people from these places visit Japan.

In total, foreign visitors spent 2.2 trillion yen in Japan from July to September 2026. They spent the most money on hotels, about 35% of the total. Shopping was second, at about 28%, and food and drinks were third, at about 23%.
